intro: The beauty lies in the details. Here is everything families usually ask us.

items.q: Where are you based, and do you travel?
items.a: Our studio is in Sallaghari, Bhaktapur. We cover the whole Kathmandu Valley at no extra travel cost, travel across Nepal (see the travel zones on the packages page), and take weddings abroad on a custom quote.

items.q: How do we book our date?
items.a: Check your date with us on WhatsApp or the contact form, have a free 20-minute call, then lock the date with a 30% advance. Dates in Mangsir, Magh and Falgun fill up months ahead.

items.q: Our saait is only in BS. Is that fine?
items.a: Of course. Send us the date in BS or AD, and we’ll confirm it either way.

items.q: Can we book only a pre-wedding shoot?
items.a: Yes. A 3-hour pre-wedding shoot is NPR 25,000 on its own, or it’s included in the Mangal and Shubha packages, for one side or both families.

items.q: Who do we talk to on the wedding day?
items.a: You get one lead from our team, who has your timeline and family list. Ask a cousin or friend to be your point person, so you can enjoy the day.

items.q: Can we also have another photographer or videographer?
items.a: Yes, as long as we agree positions beforehand so nobody blocks the rituals.

items.q: Do you know Newari and other community rituals?
items.a: We cover Brahmin, Chhetri, Newari, Madhesi, Tamang and other ceremonies, and go through the order of rituals with you before the day.

items.q: What are family blessing recordings?
items.a: Short audio or video messages from parents, grandparents and friends, recorded before or on the day. We weave them into your film, and they often become the most precious part.

items.q: What do we receive?
items.a: All edited photos on a 64 GB pendrive and Google Drive, a highlight film for each event, and the albums and frames in your package. Usually 600–1,200 edited photos for each wedding day.

items.q: How long does delivery take?
items.a: A sneak peek of 15–20 photos within 48 hours. The full gallery in 3–4 weeks, highlight films in 4–6 weeks, and albums 4–5 weeks after you choose your photos.

items.q: Who chooses the music and film title?
items.a: We suggest music that fits your story, and you can send us songs you love. We use licensed music where the film will be posted online.

items.q: Can we get the raw footage or raw photos?
items.a: Raw files are not included, but you can request them for a fee.

items.q: Will vendors be credited?
items.a: Yes. We credit your venue, makeup, decor and other vendors on your story page, and tag them when we post.

items.q: How do payments work?
items.a: 30% advance to lock the date, 50% on the first event day, and 20% before the album and final delivery. We accept bank transfer, eSewa, Khalti, Fonepay QR and cash.

items.q: What if we need to move our date?
items.a: You can move your booking once within 12 months, subject to availability. The advance is not refundable.

items.q: Will you post our photos online?
items.a: We share selected moments on our website and Instagram only with your consent. You can opt out in the contract at any time.

items.q: Do you offer both wedding photography and videography?
items.a: Yes. Our wedding photographers and cinematographers work as one team, so your photos and films tell the same story. We make cinematic highlight films of 4–6 minutes, full wedding films and Instagram reels. Need more cover? Add a photographer for NPR 12,000 or a videographer for NPR 15,000.

items.q: Which areas do you cover?
items.a: Travel is included in Kathmandu, Lalitpur, Bhaktapur and Kirtipur. Banepa, Dhulikhel, Panauti, Nagarkot and Chitlang add NPR 4,000 a day for transport. Places up to about six hours by road, like Pokhara, Chitwan and Gorkha, add 15%, and the family covers transport, rooms and meals. Farther places such as Biratnagar or Nepalgunj add 25%, and weddings outside Nepal get a custom quote.

items.q: How much does a wedding photographer cost in Nepal?
items.a: With us, one wedding day costs NPR 40,000 for the bride side, NPR 45,000 for the groom side or NPR 80,000 for both sides. Packages start at NPR 70,000 (Saath, bride side) and cost less than adding events up one by one. Book 90 or more days ahead for 5% off.

items.q: Do you have a photo studio in Bhaktapur?
items.a: Yes. Our photo studio is in Sallaghari, Bhaktapur, open Sunday to Friday, 10am to 6pm, and Saturdays by appointment. Families meet us there to plan their wedding, and we use it for studio shoots such as maternity portraits. Call 9862185128 or 9808807033 before you come.

items.q: विवाहको फोटो र भिडियोको मूल्य कति पर्छ, र बुकिङ कसरी गर्ने?
items.a: हाम्रा विवाह प्याकेजहरू रु. ७०,००० (साथ, बेहुलीपक्ष) बाट सुरु हुन्छन्। विवाहको एक दिन मात्र चाहिएमा बेहुलीपक्षलाई रु. ४०,०००, बेहुलापक्षलाई रु. ४५,००० र दुवै पक्षलाई रु. ८०,००० पर्छ। ९० दिनअगावै बुक गर्नुभयो भने ५% छुट पाउनुहुन्छ। मिति पक्का गर्न 9862185128 वा 9808807033 मा फोन गर्नुहोस्।
